meta.name: gstack-design-shotgun
meta.description: GStack design-shotgun method for rapidly exploring multiple distinct design directions before choosing one to implement or polish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速探索多个设计方向，再选定一个深入打磨
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在设计初期快速生成多种创意方向
copy.tagline_en: Rapidly explore multiple design directions before committing to one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate diverse design concepts quickly in early stages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会快速生成多个不同的设计方案，并给出优缺点对比和推荐，帮你快速探索方向。
howto.when: 当你需要多个视觉方向、设计需求不明确，或直接说“使用 gstack-design-shotgun”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用设计散弹法做几个海报方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成多个不同风格的海报设计方向。

say.text: 这个UI需求比较开放，用设计散弹法探索一下。
say.note: Claude 会产出多个UI概念并推荐最佳方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will quickly generate multiple distinct design concepts, compare tradeoffs, and recommend a winner to help you explore directions rapidly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need multiple visual directions, a brief is open-ended, or you explicitly invoke "$gstack-design-shotgun".

say_en.text: Use design shotgun to create several poster concepts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate multiple poster design directions.

say_en.text: This UI brief is open-ended, explore with design shotgun.
say_en.note: Claude will produce multiple UI concepts and recommend the best.
